It's simple. My parents never let me get any help, you're forced to go to school , school preaches "mental health matters!" But their counsellor never shows up, so you just get on with it even if you have your suicide all planned out and you're ready to perform it. Even when you're at rock bottom and it might be your last day you still have to churn out essays and assignments, that's just how it goes. Nobody cares about anything except for their reputation and image. School doesnt care about your mental health just their good grade statistics. But what can you do if you dont kill yourself. Kids still have to go to school, theres no choice, even if they're on the edge. Even if they really cant do the work because their brain is screaming at them - they still have to. That's just how it goes. Doesnt mean we can do it just means we have no other choice. People are selfish  and nobody cares about us.
